title: Hearthfield Go: Play Free Online RPG
author: True_Woodpecker2118
selftext: Bare bones beta. Literally days in. Looking for people to break the core mechanics and provide feedback for this very early days mobile game. See if im heading in a good direction. How i used AI. I have used the prompt to build approach with tesana to layer from a prototype to a beta, with core mechanics. the game atm is purely an aspect. i use this tool as an experimental update engine. i wanna see the limitations of what i can make. so far with retro graphics that seems to be quite alot of potential. and hopefully make my dream game!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/True_Woodpecker2118 please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with bare game links. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.
